items.title: Example 3.44
items.prompt_text: In the morning, the temperature in Urbana, Illinois was $11$ degrees Fahrenheit. By mid-afternoon, the temperature had dropped to $−9$ degrees Fahrenheit. What was the difference between the morning and afternoon temperatures?

items.prompt_text: The temperature in Denver was $−6$ degrees Fahrenheit at lunchtime. By sunset the temperature had dropped to $−\text{15 degree Fahrenheit}.$ What was the difference between the lunchtime and sunset temperatures?

items.prompt_text: Dinesh hiked from Mt. Whitney, the highest point in California, to Death Valley, the lowest point. The elevation of Mt. items.prompt_text: One day, John hiked to the $10,023 foot$ summit of Haleakala volcano in Hawaii. The next day, while scuba diving, he dove to a cave $80 feet$ below sea level. What is the difference between the elevation of the summit of Haleakala and the depth of the cave?

items.title: Try It 3.90
items.prompt_text: The submarine Nautilus is at $340 feet$ below the surface of the water and the submarine Explorer is $573 feet$ below the surface of the water. What is the difference in the position of the Nautilus and the Explorer?

items.prompt_text: Leslie has $\$\text{25}$ in her checking account and she writes a check for $\$\text{8}.$ ⓐ What is the balance after she writes the check? ⓑ She writes a second check for $\$\text{20}.$ What is the new balance after this check? ⓒ Leslie’s friend told her that she had lost a check for $\$\text{10}$ that Leslie had given her with her birthday card. What is the balance in Leslie’s checking account now?
